summary: Backend-only RED-first contract run completed for portal operational request/work/entitlement and strict SubmitRequest model. New tests were authored and executed against the public URL; failures confirm current STUBBED portal behavior and missing portal_operational model module.

critical.issue: Module/class missing (ModuleNotFoundError: services.portal_operational.models); strict SubmitRequest contract cannot run.
POST 202 response lacks required durable fields request_id/work_id/objective_hash/state; returns stub envelope only.
OS consumer endpoints absent (404), so same-record contract with portal request cannot be verified.
Nonexistent request returns 200 Stopped instead of 404; fake terminal transition risk.
Without licence, response returns fixed period/zero allowance_state instead of explicit unresolved status with allowance_state=null.

minor.issue: Extra caller fields principal_id/tenant_id/approver_id/answer_stub/class_label are not refused (expects 422).
Unknown/cross-tenant units (e.g., digicow_mysql) accepted with 202 instead of 403/422 refusal.
Same-key replay and key-collision semantics cannot be validated because response has no request_id and no conflict path implemented.

action_items: Implement services.portal_operational.models.SubmitRequest with strict constraints: objective_text required, operation in canonical six, units distinct size 1..50, idempotency_key length 8..128, extra forbidden.
Implement durable portal request persistence and identity-scoped list/detail with same request_id/work_id, objective_hash, state, and history redaction.
Add /api/os/work and /api/os/work/{id} as same-record consumer over persisted request/work store.
Enforce idempotency: same body+key returns same ID; same key+different body returns 409.
Refuse forged identity/approval/result fields and cross-tenant/unknown units with 422/403.
Fix stop/retry semantics: nonexistent -> 404, stop only from actual Executing state, no synthetic stop success.
Change entitlement allowance no-licence behavior to explicit unresolved and null allowance_state (no fixed period/zero fabrication).
critical_code_review_comments: portal_requests router currently returns hardcoded acceptance envelope and never writes/reads durable records, causing contract drift across ID/state/history paths.
portal_requests stop/retry handlers do not load request state by id+principal and therefore can emit synthetic outcomes for nonexistent records.
portal_entitlement allowance handler uses hardcoded period and zero credits in stub derivation, violating unresolved/no-fabrication expectation when licence is absent.
Current portal request payload is untyped dict without strict schema validation; caller-injected identity/approval fields pass through unchecked.
